title: Disciples II
summary: Starts the game in full screen with Wine's renderer: in a window it stops with "Can't initialize Disciples II". The picture is then cut or off its pointer; for 4:3 at full height add DisciplesGL to the game's folder yourself - its settings are already made. Controls: left stick pointer, A/B mouse buttons, right stick scrolls; d-pad spell/buildings, research/resurrect/retreat, centre/defend, heal; ZL capital/auto battle; L/R leaders; X Enter, Y Esc; ZR quick save; stick clicks continue a move and end the turn. Keeps your own controls file. Tested with GOG v2.02.
